regions.today: A cloudy day today with just isolated drizzle patches at first. Further scattered patches of light rain and drizzle will spread from the northwest through the day. Humid with highest temperatures of 17 to 21 degrees in moderate westerly winds.
regions.tonight: Tonight will be cloudy with a few patches of light rain and drizzle. Some mist and hill fog will develop also. Lowest temperatures of 13 to15 degrees in moderate westerly winds.
regions.tomorrow: A cloudy start tomorrow with a few patches of drizzle and mist lingering at first. It will brighten up near east and southeast coasts through the afternoon with sunny spells slowly developing. Remaining dull elsewhere. Highest temperatures of 17 to 21 degrees in moderate westerly winds.
regions.solar_uv: Low to moderate on Saturday. Moderate to high on Sunday.
